hits.title: Discovered Materials Raises $9 Mn In Seed Funding Led By Lightspeed ...
hits.snippet: # Discovered Materials Raises $9 Mn In Seed Funding Led By Lightspeed India Partners Discovered Materials, a startup developing artificial intelligence agents to discover new materials for semiconductor chips, has raised USD 9 million, or approximately Rs 85 crore, in a seed funding round led by Lightspeed India Partners, according to a media report. Y Combinator, Peak XV Partners and angel investors including Paul Graham, Gokul Rajaram and Anthropic executive Thariq Shihipar also participated in the funding round.
